mfaMethod.title: MFA verification methods
mfaMethod.description: Platform-wide switches for multi-factor authentication methods. Same rules as feature flags: off overrides every tenant; on or default lets tenant-level settings apply (in the tenant's Multi-factor authentication tab). Methods available to platform admins come from PLATFORM_MFA_METHODS.
mfaMethod.needsSettings: Fill in its settings to turn it on

settings.title: {{name}} settings
settings.description: Platform settings this method needs. It can't be turned on until the required ones are filled in. Saving checks them against the provider.
settings.clearDescription: The method can't be turned on again until you fill them in. You can't delete them while the method is on.
